observations: Six PS5 game cases: Grand Theft Auto V, FIFA 23, Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Watch Dogs Legion, Mortal Kombat 11 Ultimate, and The Last of Us Part I.
Dual controller charging station with a PlayStation logo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DERA THEO' overlaid on the image.
The photo is professionally staged, perfectly lit, and lacks any cables or signs of a domestic environment, characteristic of a stock or promotional image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only two controllers in total.
Photo 0 shows six physical game cases; digital or 'in built' games cannot be verified from a still photo.

risks.risk: The photo appears to be a stock image and may not represent the actual item in the seller's possession.
risks.proof: A photo of the console and accessories next to a handwritten note with the seller's name and today's date.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a faulty disc drive.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and loading a physical disc.

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift or internal faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers functioning in a game or test menu.

risks.risk: Digital games ('in built') are often tied to a personal account and may be inaccessible to the buyer.
risks.proof: Confirmation of account transfer or video of games launching.

proof_requests: A photo of the actual items with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and today's date.
A photo showing all 4 controllers and all 8 games mentioned in the text.
A video of the console powering on and playing one of the discs.
Photos of the open game cases showing the discs.
response.reason: The listing uses a professionally staged stock-style photograph rather than a photo of the actual item. Furthermore, the seller's text claims 'Extra 3 pads' (implying 4 total) and '8 games', which directly contradicts the 2 pads and 6 games visible in the photo.
